eidolons.name: Shed Scales of Old
eidolons.desc: When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) and increases the "Bondmate's" All-Type RES PEN by 18%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Watch Trails to Blaze
eidolons.desc: Additionally increases the number of actions for the enhanced Souldragon from Ultimate by 2. After Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, Souldragon advances action by 100%. When the enhanced "Souldragon" takes action, the Additional DMG dealt by the "Bondmate" becomes 200% of its original DMG, and the Shield Effect provided in this instance becomes 200% of its original Shield Effect.

eidolons.name: Bear Weight of Worlds
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: By Oath, This Vessel Is I
eidolons.desc: Reduces the DMG taken by the "Bondmate" by 20%.

eidolons.name: The Path of Permanence Sweeps Far
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: One Dream to Enfold All Wilds
eidolons.desc: When the "Bondmate" is on the field, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by 20%. When the "Bondmate" deals DMG, ignores 12% of the enemy targets' DEF. When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, the "Bondmate" will deal Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type to all enemies, equal to 330% of the Bondmate's ATK.

basic.name: Aegis Vitae
basic.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to {0}% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Terra Omnibus
skill.desc:
Designates one ally character as the "Bondmate" and provides all allies with a Shield that can offset DMG equal to {0}% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus {1} for 3 turn(s). When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, can stack the Shield Effect, but it will not exceed 300% of the current Shield provided by Skill.
"Bondmate" only applies to the most recent target of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Skill.

ult.name: A Dragon's Zenith Knows No Rue
ult.desc:
Deals Physical DMG equal to {0}% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK to all enemies, and provides a Shield to all allies that can offset DMG equal to {2}% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus {3}, lasting for 3 turn(s). When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, can stack the Shield Effect, but it will not exceed 300% of the current Shield provided by Skill.
"Souldragon" becomes enhanced. When "Souldragon" takes action, launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies equal to {1}% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK and Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type to all enemies equal to {4}% of the Bondmate's ATK. The enhancement lasts for 2 "Souldragon" action(s).

talent.name: Of Virtue, Forms Unfold
talent.desc:
When an ally character becomes the "Bondmate," Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae summons "Souldragon" for them, which has an initial SPD of 165.
When "Souldragon" takes action, dispels 1 debuff(s) from all allies and provides a Shield that can offset DMG equal to {0}% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus {1} for 3 turn(s). The Shield Effect provided by Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae and "Souldragon" can be stacked, but it will not exceed 300% of the Shield provided by Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Skill.
When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae or the "Bondmate" is knocked down, "Souldragon" disappears.

technique.name: Earthrend
technique.desc:
After using Technique, gains "Bondmate" and inflict Daze on enemies within a certain area for 10 second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack ally targets.
When switching the active character, "Bondmate" transfers to the current active character. At the start of the next battle, automatically uses Skill 1 time on the character with "Bondmate" without consuming any Skill Points.

ability_1.name: Empyreanity
ability_1.desc: When using Skill, increases ATK for the target who has become "Bondmate" by an amount equal to 15% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK.

ability_2.name: Sylvanity
ability_2.desc: When combat starts, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae advances action by 40%. When the "Bondmate" uses an attack, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae regenerates 6 Energy and "Souldragon" advances action by 15%.

ability_3.name: Sublimity
ability_3.desc: When "Souldragon" takes action, additionally provides a Shield that can offset DMG equal to 5% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus 100 to the ally target whose current Shield Effect is the lowest. When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, can stack the Shield Effect, but it will not exceed 300% of the current Shield provided by Skill. When the enhanced "Souldragon" takes action, additionally deals 1 instance of Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type to the one enemy target whose current HP is the highest, equal to 40% of the Bondmate's ATK.

lightCones.name: Though Worlds Apart
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by 64%. When the wearer uses Ultimate, restores HP equal to 10% of the wearer's ATK for all allies, and additionally restores HP equal to 10% of the wearer's ATK for the character with the lowest current HP, and grants "Redoubt" to all allies for 3 turns. Targets with "Redoubt" deal 24% more DMG, which further increases by 12% if the targets have summons.

lightCones.name: Journey, Forever Peaceful
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's provided Shield Effect by 12%. When an ally target has a Shield, the DMG dealt increases by 12%.

lightCones.name: She Already Shut Her Eyes
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 24%/28%/32%/36%/40% and Energy Regeneration Rate by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. When the wearer's HP is reduced, all allies' DMG dealt increases by 9%/10.5%/12%/13.5%/15%, for 2 turn(s). At the start of every wave, restores HP to all allies by an amount equal to 80%/85%/90%/95%/100% of their respective lost HP.

relicSets.name: Self-Enshrouded Recluse
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases Shield Effect by 10%. 4-pc: Increases Shield Effect provided by the wearer by 12%. When an ally target has a Shield provided by the wearer, their CRIT DMG increases by 15%.

planarSets.name: Lushaka, the Sunken Seas
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. If the wearer is not the first character in the team lineup, then increase the ATK of the first character in the team lineup by 12%.

teams.name: Permansor Terrae F2P Team
teams.description: Permansor Terrae's best free-to-play team has Dan Heng as his DPS unit. Permansor Terrae can comfortably provide team-wide shields while also providing Dan Heng ATK buffs along with Asta and Yukong's buffs.

teams.name: Permansor Terrae Single DPS Team
teams.description:
Permansor Terrae is best used in a team that focuses on a single DPS, due to him only having one Bondmate at a time. That Bondmate should ideally be able to take multiple turns within a cycle for Permansor Terrae's energy generation.

The supports must also have ways to make the team take multiple turns within a cycle to fully utilize this team.

teams.name: Permansor Terrae DoT Team
teams.description: Permansor Terrae can work well with characters that deal DoT damage due to their ATK scaling. The only downside would be the fact that only one character can be his Bondmate when a DoT team usually consists of 2 or more DoT characters.

lore.description:
The chest of Georios, the body of the fallen dragon supporting the shattered earth, enduring millennia of pain.
Dan Heng, the Nameless and the Chrysos Heir who guards the Earth's Coreflame, steadies the world before it falls and guides all life across the land to a new home beyond.
Rivers flow to the sea, mountains echo in harmony, and the eternal path stretches ten thousand miles.
stories: He never imagined this day would come, when the Trailblaze seemed to screech to an abrupt halt. The acrid smell of blood spread as the wrecked car spewed choking smoke and dust. He struggled to his feet, groping for direction in the darkness. Tick-tock, tick-tock... In the deathly silence, only the echoes of life slipping away remained. "Trailblazer..." The deformed components in the car blocked his path. Fighting through excruciating pain, he removed the obstacles one by one. Warm blood trickled down his fingertips, but what terrified him more was that he could barely sense that familiar breathing anymore. "Let's... go home together." He administered the medicine he carried, the nearly depleted spirit water swirling in his palm, but against such horrific wounds, even healing was futile. The Black Tide Creatures prowled, surrounding them both with their howls. The Cloud-Piercer shattered, crashing onto desolate rocks. The spirit water turned crimson as he used his last ounce of strength to shield Trailblazer He woke up from the nightmare, gasping for breath. ... "What's up? Is there something on my face?" At breakfast the next day, his gray-haired companion asked curiously. "Thankfully it's not like in the dream..." But he didn't say it out loud, just turned his gaze to the sky outside the window, "It's nothing... eat up." The sky over Okhema remained azure blue. But he couldn't help his thoughts from wandering, "I wonder if March is doing alright..." The car plummeted like a burning meteor. Would she, arriving later, meet the same fate? Or perhaps something even worse... He shook his head, pushing away the chaotic thoughts. Another new day dawns. With recording tools in hand, he prepares to head to the market. The Trailblaze journey seems to be going as usual.

His Trailblaze often begins with exploration and understanding. "Little Dannie, hold on tight, sit tight, here we go..." He sought knowledge of lost history from the red-haired girl, and they invited him to a history lesson overlooking the world. "Kremnos's tradition?" "Yes. May we have a duel?" He asked the golden-haired crown prince. By the side, a white-haired youth was eager to try. "I want to join as well. Traditions like this are better experienced." The proud lion of Kremnos kept silent, responding only with a stance. ... He ventured to the Grove, poring over every book in its collection, as the shattered world gradually took shape in his mind. To find a way back to the stars, he delved deep into the ruins, investigating the mysteries of the world beyond the sky. He records everything he experiences, just as he has done at every stop along the way. But when the fate of the world rests upon a hero's shoulders, he knows that this "Trailblaze" cannot be reduced to mere cold entries. Those were pivotal battles, each and every one. Together with companions, they ended the history of "Strife" and witnessed the crown prince of Kremnos break from tradition. Trailblazer joined the fray, returning the Coreflame of Time. When he returned from the treacherous nether realm, he still couldn't forget the joy of that day, like one who had survived a catastrophe. Those were also countless moments of farewell. The Holy Maiden's thousand forms withered, the sage was reduced to ashes, and the daughter of the River of Souls bid her final farewell to the mortal realm... He remembered at the time of parting, they were either sorrowful or content, but never once did they show any regret. "If one day, we too shall come to this..." Thinking of Trailblazer's destiny and March 7th who had yet to arrive, he too had spent sleepless nights over this. "For a thousand years, we have all been prepared to face sacrifice, or to sacrifice ourselves for our companions..." He had seen it more than once... The weaver gathering relics, embroidering them with a golden flower. "Now... there are no regrets left." Compared to the existence of the Permanence, their lives were like fleeting fyreflies. Yet he could clearly see those twinkling lights illuminating the night sky they had traversed and would traverse together. As Okhema falls into the blood-red twilight, the prophesied moment shall arrive. Yet facing the inevitable strike from the black-clad swordmaster, his heart remains as calm as the vast ocean. He believes Trailblazer will forge ahead without hesitation. By the faint glow of the Flame-Chase, he too caught a glimpse of the path he must take.

At the end of Era Nova, the cold testing ground reveals its cruel core. The tidal waves of the Remembrance merge into a tsunami, engulfing the pathstrider of Trailblaze. When he awakens, his companions are already lost in the bottomless Memory Zone. He felt as if he'd returned to those solitary days before boarding the Express, yet the pain of this moment told him this was more than just a nightmare. The moment he stepped back into the memoria tide, fragments of the past came rushing towards him... "...Their heartbeat and pulse are very weak. March, get ready to perform CPR." "Huh!? I... I don't have much experience with that. Dan Heng, you do it!" He remembered their fateful first encounter with Trailblazer. "I'm just imagining all the fun stuff that'll happen to us three... hehe!" On the streets of Belobog, snow once blanketed their shoulders, and sharing a steaming hot wrap was enough to warm up the entire winter night. "...As a descendant of the Vidyadhara, I will fulfill my duty to the Luofu." In the presence of Trailblazer and March 7th, he broke free from the shadows of his past, as their laughter and chatter gradually melted away his snow-heavy memories. "What did you encounter in Ena's Dream?" "I dreamed of the Express passing station after station, with people coming and going, yet we five remained together throughout. This journey seemed as if it would never end." In a similar Memory Zone, they had once escaped Penacony's dream together, leaving the most desired future to reality. "Dan Heng, how much more can you sacrifice?" The voice in his heart questioned his resolve, and he answered with decisive action. The fading demigod entrusted the Coreflame to him. The moment he grasped it, countless gazes of desperate souls seemed to ignite his very being. At the moment the Sacred Tree fell, he shouldered the burden of a world's creatures, fusing their bloodline with the earth of Amphoreus. He ventured into the depths of earth's root system, searching for the direction of his companions. Through vast jungles and endless seas, he traversed wind and frost, crossed the Dead Sea desert, and sometimes lost his way in this complex world. In every moment when he stepped into darkness, he could always feel that gentle gaze behind him. "We're retracing our old flight paths, with so much to redo. We need a guard... and an archiver." "I am 'Dan Heng'..." Along the inescapable path of the past, the wild dragon roars as it breaks free from all restraints, soaring towards the unfinished road ahead... "I am... the one who guards the path of Trailblaze!"

He felt as if he was back on the speeding Astral Express. He watched as the Express ventured into the vast unknown, blazing trails never traveled before. In the endlessly stretching path through space, he saw a giant dragon soaring through chaos. It once slumbered in its egg, until one day it emerged in rebirth. It met others of its kind, sharing the same bloodline and path. It stirred vast spirit waters, bringing rain and nourishing all living things. It upheld the earth of gold and stone, protecting the eternal prosperity of all nations... Its path still winds toward the future. War's flames licked its scales, and from that heat, it shed its old scales time and time again, gaining rebirth. Then, together with the Express, it leaped toward the future. ... "You know, in the future, if the Express gets covered in a layer of cosmic barnacles that won't wash off, Dan Heng can use his... Dragonquake Boom to sand them away!" "Great idea. Look, Dan Heng's waking up... Want to bet whether it was a good dream or..." "You guys are too noisy..." As soon as he opened his eyes, he saw Trailblazer and March whispering loudly next to his ear. "Come on, spill it! Falling asleep at a time like this. What sweet dreams were you having?" March stretched lazily, gazing into the distance with anticipation. "Let me guess, did you dream about what's going to happen on our upcoming journey?" "..." "Do you even need to ask? Of course we're gonna beat up all the bad guys!" The wind that blew then seemed to carry the aroma of breakfast from the Express. "Let's... go home together." He made a silent vow, as he had in the past, and would in the future.
